ValidationRule.description: FBD field is Required to enter Stage 4 for all New and Upsell deals with a value greater than or equal to $25kUSD
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '4 - Negotiate'), OR(ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Up-Sell'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal')), Total_Booked_Amount__c > 25000, OR(IM_Booked_Date__c < today(),ISBLANK(IM_Booked_Date__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The First Bill Date is mandatory to enter Stage 4 for all New and Upsell deals with a value greater than or equal to $25kUSD
